scenes.title: The New Intern
scenes.summary: New directing intern Alessandro arrives looking for the director while Rene pep-talks his goldfish Boris; assistant director Arianna stops Alessandro in the corridor and orders him to wait quietly.

scenes.title: Change Your Mindset
scenes.summary: Network delegate Lopez urges the crew to change their mindset for The Eyes of the Heart 2, until chief electrician Biascica asks about unpaid April overtime and production manager Sergio says they will never see that money.

scenes.title: Three Rules and Seven Coffees
scenes.summary: Arianna gives Alessandro three strict rules for surviving on set and hands him to Biascica, who approves of his support for Roma and tells him to guard the light stands and make seven coffees.

scenes.title: You Will Be Called Seppia
scenes.summary: As the crew prepares scene 168, lead actor Stanis La Rochelle arrives from a forbidden tennis match, spars with Arianna about his contract, and renames Alessandro Seppia.

scenes.title: Before the First Take
scenes.summary: Arianna turns Rene's blunt message into warm praise to flatter star actress Corinna in makeup, then Rene persuades Corinna to shoot scene 168 without rehearsing after a round of applause.
scenes.location: Corinna's dressing room and Studio 2 set

scenes.title: Twenty-Four Years Old
scenes.summary: During the first take of scene 168, Corinna changes her character's age from thirty-four to twenty-four and refuses Rene and Arianna's pleas to follow the script, citing network head Dr. Cane.

scenes.title: Foosball on Set
scenes.summary: With filming stalled over Corinna's age, Biascica recruits Alessandro for a foosball match, while Arianna logs the network delay and sends Alessandro to find Duccio for a backup scene.

scenes.title: Stanis Wants to Quit
scenes.summary: While Alessandro searches for Duccio, Stanis tells Arianna he is unhappy and claims his lawyers are breaking his contract, until Arianna calls his bluff.

scenes.title: Worse Than the Commercials
scenes.summary: In his dim dressing room, director of photography Duccio explains to Alessandro why soap-opera lighting is deliberately awful: it must never look better than the commercials, or viewers change channels.

scenes.title: A Journalist on Set
scenes.summary: Sergio caves in on the phone with the network and promises to solve the age dispute, while Rene apologises to Alessandro and points out a newspaper journalist writing an article about the show.

scenes.title: Mistaken for the Journalist
scenes.summary: Mistaking Alessandro for the Repubblica journalist Di Pollina, Corinna dictates her berry-scented shower routine and invites him to a Sunday calendar shoot, right before Arianna throws him off the set.

scenes.title: See You Tomorrow at Seven-Thirty
scenes.summary: On set, Corinna shoots a compromise line avoiding any number for her age and Rene calls it a print; outside, Rene tells the bewildered Alessandro to report back tomorrow at 7:30 sharp.

scenes.title: Closing credits
scenes.summary: Closing theme song over the end credits.
